classification.difficultyReason: Complete the supplied ordered-pair table using its examples, then count one specified outcome and the matching-number diagonal over 16 outcomes. The table and definition of doubles scaffold direct application.

inlines.text: Complete the table to list the outcomes.
Read each ordered pair as (first result, second result), following the column and row headings. Every response cell is included.

answer.worked:
There is one $(2,3)$ outcome among the 16 equally likely outcomes.
$$P((2,3))=\frac{1}{16}$$

children.prompt: Find $P(\text{double})$. A double is an outcome with two of the same number.
